request: Create a UML diagram for a coffee vending machine’s state transitions
mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> Selecting : "coin inserted"
    Selecting --> Payment : "selection made"
    Payment --> Dispensing : "payment accepted"
    Payment --> Selecting : "payment declined"
    Dispensing --> Idle : "drink dispensed"
    Dispensing --> OutOfService : "error detected"
    OutOfService --> Maintenance : "service requested"
    Maintenance --> Idle : "maintenance completed"
    Idle --> OutOfService : "out of stock"

request: Show the data flow for a smart thermostat adjusting temperature automatically
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Start]
    B[Read temperature sensor]
    C[Read desired setpoint]
    D{Is temperature < setpoint?}
    E[Turn heating on]
    F{Is temperature > setpoint?}
    G[Turn cooling on]
    H[Maintain current state]
    I[End]
    A --> B --> C --> D
    D -->|Yes| E --> I
    D -->|No| F
    F -->|Yes| G --> I
    F -->|No| H --> I

request: Design a class diagram for an e‑learning platform with courses and quizzes
mermaid:
classDiagram
    class Platform
    class Course
    class Lesson
    class Quiz
    class Question
    class Answer
    class User
    class Instructor
    class Student
    class Enrollment
    class Result
    Platform "1" --> "*" Course : hosts
    Course "1" --> "*" Lesson : contains
    Course "1" --> "*" Quiz : includes
    Quiz "1" --> "*" Question : has
    Question "1" --> "*" Answer : provides
    User <|-- Instructor
    User <|-- Student
    Student "1" --> "*" Enrollment : registers
    Enrollment "*" --> "1" Course : for
    Student "1" --> "*" Result : achieves
    Result "*" --> "1" Quiz : for
    Result "*" --> "1" Question : on
    Result "*" --> "1" Answer : selected
